attendance.title: Instructor-confirmed attendance
attendance.description: Registered rosters, present/absent/unconfirmed records, UTC confirmation timestamps and change history. Sustained anonymous tracks may support explicit instructor identity review; detection never marks a student automatically.

video.title: Local video observations
video.description: Recorded video and explicit browser camera snapshots. OpenCV frame differences, recorded-video HOG person estimates, frontal Haar faces and anonymous IoU tracks with configurable sustained-presence thresholds. Head pose is unsupported; eye-line roll is only a 2D image heuristic. No identity recognition. Classroom accuracy and real capture hardware remain unvalidated; face thumbnails are optional and off by default.

audio.title: Audio activity indicators
audio.description: Recorded PCM WAV or explicit browser microphone capture encoded as WAV. RMS energy, sound-active intervals/bouts and bounded speech-like heuristic intervals. No speech recognition, verified speech, speaker attribution or conversation understanding. Extraction and compressed formats require FFmpeg. Capture is limited to two minutes and analyzed after explicit upload.

analytics.title: Session-level analytics
analytics.description: Attendance and recording charts plus a timestamp-aligned observable activity index with explicit formula and missing-signal coverage. Separate same-session video/WAV can be aligned manually. The index is not a validated engagement, attention or learning score; no individual student score exists.

recommendations.title: Advisory teaching suggestions
recommendations.description: Evidence-linked local rules and optional Gemini suggestions using aggregate session metrics, subject to instructor review.

exports.title: Reviewable records and exports
exports.description: Attendance CSV with timestamps/source, session JSON with attendance and latest 500 history entries per session, and browser print/PDF reports. JSON excludes face thumbnails. Files can contain student information.

limitations: The current implementation is a local, single-instructor application with explicitly demo-only login; it is not a secure institutional identity system or multi-tenant platform.
No LMS/SIS integrations, cloud deployment, automated email delivery, compliance certifications, institutional customers or validated learning outcomes are established.
Media consent, retention, access control, backups and institutional governance require assessment before a real pilot. No accuracy guarantee is made for classroom detection.
Institution-managed and public cloud are consultation preferences, not delivered deployment capabilities. Automated signals do not establish identity, attention, emotion or learning.
